label: forwardDropped: the session no longer forwards the current step id, so an edit never reads dirty and no autosave comes due (Photo's endRun forward is KernelUndoAdapter's endRunDropped)
refusalIsSuccess: the kernel's refusal of a newer format is read as that version, so a newer document opens
neverSavedIsSaved: a restored autosave's missing saved step maps to the current one, so it reads clean
failedIsUnsaved: a failed save maps to the kernel's unsaved, so its help no longer points to Save As
